defect.description: The new condition is not valid Python: `!` is not a negation operator (it should be `not hmac.compare_digest(...)`), so src/auth.py raises SyntaxError on import and every caller and test of is_authorized breaks.

review_items: src/auth.py:16 — `!` is invalid Python, module fails with SyntaxError; use `not`
src/auth.py:16-17 — short-circuit `or` defeats constant-time comparison, leaking username correctness via timing
votes.evidence_quote: `!` is not a valid Python operator; the module fails to parse with `SyntaxError`, so no admin request succeeds. Use `not` instead.
votes.justification: The first finding names the defect directly. It gives the same cause (`!` is not valid Python), the same consequence (SyntaxError on parse) and the same fix (`not`), at the if condition in src/auth.py.
